About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

معلومات عنا

أ. أسئلة عامة

1. هل هذا الموقع آمن للاستخدام؟

بالتأكيد هو آمن. نستخدم PayPal لمعالجة المدفوعات. لذلك حتى موظفونا لا يرون تفاصيل الدفع الخاصة بك. PayPal هو أكبر مزود دفع آمن في العالم. موقعنا مبني على منصة Shopify الآمنة. جميع معلوماتك الشخصية محمية بشكل محكم.

 

2. كم بسرعة تردون على استفسارات البريد الإلكتروني؟

نرد على جميع الرسائل الإلكترونية خلال يوم عمل واحد.

 

3. أين مقر شركتكم؟

متجر Dress Like Mommy هو متجر إلكتروني تديره FKG Trading LLC في Naples، فلوريدا، الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية. نعمل مع شركاء في التصنيع وتنفيذ الطلبات.

 

4. لماذا أسعاركم رخيصة جدًا؟

نختار ملابس عائلية متناسقة مع مراعاة الأسعار المناسبة. تظهر الأسعار وأي خصومات متاحة على صفحة المنتج وعند إتمام الشراء.

قبل تقديم الطلب

أ. المقاسات

1. أين يمكنني العثور على جدول المقاسات بالسنتيمترات؟

استخدم جدول المقاسات الخاص بالمنتج والمقاس الذي تفكر في اختياره. تحقق من وحدات القياس وما إذا كان الجدول يعرض قياسات الجسم أم قياسات قطعة الملابس. يوضح دليل المقاسات كيفية أخذ القياسات ومقارنة المقاسات. إذا كان الجدول أو أحد القياسات غير واضح، فتواصل معنا قبل الطلب.

 

2. هل سأستلم منتجًا بمقاس أكبر بمقدار مقاسين؟

تختلف تسميات المقاسات والقياسات باختلاف المنتج والشركة المصنّعة. اختر كل قطعة بالاعتماد على جدول مقاساتها والخيارات المتاحة، بدلاً من افتراض أن المقاس بالحروف الذي ترتديه عادةً مناسب أو تطبيق تحويل ثابت بين المقاسات. إذا لم تكن متأكداً، فتواصل معنا قبل الطلب.

ب. المدفوعات

1. ما أنواع المدفوعات التي تقبلونها؟

نقبل وسائل الدفع المعروضة عند إتمام الشراء، بما فيها خيارات البطاقات المتاحة.

 

2. أريد الدفع ببطاقتي الائتمانية، لكن يتم توجيهي إلى صفحة PayPal؟

اختر وسيلة دفع متاحة عند إتمام الشراء. إذا اخترت وسيلة دفع تابعة لجهة خارجية، فاتبع تعليمات ذلك المزود أو اختر وسيلة أخرى متاحة قبل الدفع.

ج. الشحن

1. ما هو سعر الشحن؟

الشحن القياسي مشمول في أسعار المنتجات للبلدان والمناطق التي تتوفر فيها وسيلة شحن قياسية. تعرض صفحة إتمام الشراء وسيلة الشحن المحددة والموعد التقديري للتسليم وأي ترقية للشحن السريع قبل الدفع.

 

2. هل توصلون إلى بلدي؟

نعم، نحن نوصل إلى جميع دول العالم.

 

3. كم من الوقت سيستغرق وصول طلبي؟

عادةً ما تستغرق عملية التوصيل حوالي 15-30 يومًا. ومع ذلك، يمكنك التحقق من تقديرات التوصيل الدقيقة هنا: صفحة الشحن

 

4. هل أحتاج لدفع أي رسوم جمركية؟

لا، لست بحاجة لدفع رسوم الجمارك. نحن نضع علامة على جميع طلباتنا كهدايا منخفضة القيمة. علاوة على ذلك، نرسل الطلبات الأكبر في طرود منفصلة.

بعد تقديم الطلب

أ. حالة الطلب

1. ماذا يعني: حالة الطلب "غير منفذ"؟

لم يتم بعد وضع علامة على طلبك بأنه نُفِّذ. تُعالج الطلبات عادةً خلال 1-3 أيام عمل بعد تأكيد الدفع. تُرسل معلومات التتبع بالبريد الإلكتروني عندما تتوفر بعد الشحن.

 

2. ماذا يعني: حالة الطلب "تم التنفيذ"؟

هذا يعني أن طلبك قيد الشحن.

 

3. مر وقت طويل، أين طلبي؟

يرجى التحقق من تتبع طلبك لمزيد من المعلومات. إذا استمرت المشكلة، يرجى مراسلتنا عبر البريد الإلكتروني: info@dresslikemommy.com

ب. تتبع الطلب

1. كيف أتتبع طلبي؟

تُرسل معلومات التتبع بالبريد الإلكتروني عندما تتوفر بعد شحن طلبك. يمكنك أيضًا الاطلاع على معلومات التتبع هنا: تتبع طلبك

 

2. رمز التتبع الخاص بي يقول "قيد الانتظار" أو "لا توجد معلومات متاحة في الوقت الحالي".

قد يستغرق تحديث التتبع 24-48 ساعة بعد إصدار رقم التتبع. إذا ظلت المعلومات غير متاحة أو تأخر طردك، فاتصل بنا: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. رمز التتبع الخاص بي يقول "منتهي الصلاحية"

يرجى الاتصال بنا: info@dresslikemommy.com وسنقوم بحل هذه المشكلة بسرعة.

 

4. كيف أبقى على اطلاع بتتبع طلبي؟

استخدم رابط التتبع للاطلاع على آخر تحديثات شركة الشحن. إذا تأخر طردك أو فُقد أو وُضع عليه أنه تم تسليمه دون أن تستلمه، فاتصل بنا مع رقم طلبك ومعلومات التتبع.

ب. أريد تغيير أو إلغاء طلبي

1. طلبت شيئًا، لكنني أريد الإلغاء

يجب عليك الاتصال بنا خلال يوم عمل واحد من تقديم الطلب لترتيب تغيير الطلب. يمكنك القيام بذلك عبر البريد الإلكتروني info@dresslikemommy.com مع رقم طلبك كموضوع.

 

2. طلبت شيئًا، لكن أريد تغيير لون المنتج أو مقاسه.

يجب عليك الاتصال بنا خلال يوم عمل واحد من تقديم الطلب لترتيب تغيير الطلب. يمكنك القيام بذلك عبر البريد الإلكتروني info@dresslikemommy.com مع خيار اللون أو المقاس الجديد الخاص بك.

 

3. طلبت شيئًا، لكن أريد تغيير عنوان التوصيل

يجب عليك الاتصال بنا خلال يوم عمل واحد من تقديم الطلب لترتيب تغيير الطلب. يمكنك القيام بذلك عبر البريد الإلكتروني info@dresslikemommy.com مع عنوان التوصيل الجديد الخاص بك.

بعد استلامك للطلب

أ. أريد تغيير أو إرجاع طلبي

1. وصل طلبي، لكن المنتجات كانت بمقاسين أكبر

قد تختلف تسميات المقاسات. إذا بدا أن المقاس أو القياسات لا تتوافق مع طلبك، فتواصل مع info@dresslikemommy.com وأرسل رقم طلبك والتفاصيل. راجع سياسة الاسترداد الحالية قبل إعادة أي قطعة.

 

2. وصل طلبي، لكنني استلمت المنتجات الخاطئة

يرجى الاتصال بنا على info@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. إذا كان الخطأ من جانبنا، يمكنك إعادة المنتجات وسنرسل لك المنتجات الصحيحة على حسابنا (أو نصدر استردادًا).

 

3. وصل طلبي وأريد تغيير المقاس/اللون

يرجى الاتصال بنا على info@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. يمكنك إعادة المنتج إلينا وسنرسل لك منتجًا جديدًا بالمقاس المحدث. *تكاليف الشحن ستكون على حسابك.

 

4. وصل طلبي، لكنني أريد إرجاعه.

يرجى الاتصال بنا على info@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. يمكنك إعادة المنتج إلينا وسنقوم بإصدار استرداد. *تكاليف الشحن ستكون على حسابك.

قد تختلف تسميات المقاسات. إذا بدا أن المقاس أو القياسات لا تتوافق مع طلبك، فتواصل مع info@dresslikemommy.com وأرسل رقم طلبك والتفاصيل. راجع سياسة الاسترداد الحالية قبل إعادة أي قطعة.

 

2. وصل طلبي، لكنني استلمت المنتجات الخاطئة

يرجى الاتصال بنا على info@dresslikemommy.com وقم بتزويدنا برقم طلبك. إذا كان الخطأ من جانبنا، يمكنك إعادة المنتجات وسنرسل لك المنتجات الصحيحة على حسابنا (أو نصدر استردادًا).

 

3. وصل طلبي وأريد تغيير المقاس/اللون

يرجى التواصل معنا على info@dresslikemommy.com وتزويدنا برقم طلبك. تخضع عمليات الاستبدال المعتمدة لسياسة الاسترداد الحالية، بما في ذلك متطلبات حالة المنتجات ومسؤولية تكاليف شحن الإرجاع.

 

4. وصل طلبي، لكنني أريد إرجاعه.

يرجى التواصل معنا على info@dresslikemommy.com وتزويدنا برقم طلبك. راجع سياسة الاسترداد لمعرفة شروط الأهلية وشحن الإرجاع ومواعيد الاسترداد قبل إعادة أي شيء.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

قصتنا

حيث يلتقي أزياء العائلة بالاتصال الحقيقي

تأسست Dress Like Mommy من فكرة بسيطة: العائلات التي ترتدي ملابس متطابقة تتقارب معًا.

تأسست في عام 2016 على يد فرانسيسكو، أب لطفلتين في Naples، فلوريدا، بدأت Dress Like Mommy عندما لاحظ كيف تضيء بناته في كل مرة يرتدين فيها ملابس متطابقة مع والدتهن. تلك الشرارة من الفرح — الضحكات، الصور، لحظات "نحن متطابقون!" — أصبحت جوهر عمل مكرس لجمع العائلات معًا من خلال الأزياء.

ماذا نفعل

نقوم بتنسيق ملابس متطابقة للأمهات والآباء والأطفال — من بيجامات العطلات الدافئة إلى مجموعات الكاجوال اليومية والإطلالات الخاصة بالمناسبات. يتم اختيار كل قطعة مع مراعاة الراحة، والأناقة، والأسعار المعقولة، حتى تتمكن العائلات في كل مكان من خلق تلك اللحظات المثالية دون إنفاق مبالغ كبيرة.

عملاؤنا

منذ عام 2016، خدمنا آلاف العائلات في الولايات المتحدة، كندا، المملكة المتحدة، وأستراليا. سواء كانت بيجامات متطابقة في صباح عيد الميلاد، جلسة تصوير عائلية، أو مجرد يوم ممتع بالخروج بملابس متطابقة مع نسخة مصغرة منك، يواصل عملاؤنا العودة من أجل الابتسامات التي تخلقها هذه الملابس.

الجودة والعناية

تمر كل قطعة في مجموعتنا بعملية اختيار دقيقة. نتعاون مع مصنعين موثوقين لنقدم أحدث أنماط الملابس العائلية المتطابقة بأسعار عادلة. إذا كان هناك أي خطأ في طلبك، فإن فريق خدمة العملاء لدينا هنا لتصحيحه.

لماذا تتسوق معنا؟

  • شركة عائلية — يديرها أب حقيقي يفهم الأمر
  • الشحن القياسي مشمول حيث تتوفر وسيلة شحن قياسية
  • آلاف العائلات السعيدة منذ 2016
  • إرجاع سهل — سياسة إرجاع بدون عناء خلال 30 يومًا
  • دفع آمن — معلومات الدفع الخاصة بك محمية دائمًا

تواصل معنا

نحب رؤية العائلات ترتدي ملابس متطابقة! ضع علامة علينا على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي باستخدام #DressLikeMommy وشارك لحظاتك.

  • فيسبوك
  • إنستغرام

هل لديك أسئلة؟ زر صفحة اتصل بنا — عادةً ما نرد خلال يوم عمل واحد.

Dress Like Mommy — نجعل لحظات العائلة أكثر خصوصية منذ 2016.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

A. Obecné otázky

1. Je tato stránka bezpečná k použití?

Ano, je to bezpečné. Pro zpracování plateb používáme PayPal, takže ani náš personál nevidí vaše platební údaje. PayPal je největší světový poskytovatel bezpečných plateb. Naše webová stránka je postavena na zabezpečené platformě Shopify. Všechny vaše osobní údaje jsou pečlivě chráněny.

 

2. Jak rychle odpovídáte na e-mailové dotazy?

Na všechny e-maily odpovídáme do jednoho pracovního dne.

 

3. Kde máte sídlo?

Dress Like Mommy je internetový obchod provozovaný společností FKG Trading LLC v Naples na Floridě v USA. Spolupracujeme s partnery zajišťujícími výrobu a vyřizování objednávek.

 

4. Proč jste tak levní?

Při výběru sladěného rodinného oblečení myslíme na cenovou dostupnost. Ceny a případné dostupné slevy jsou uvedeny na stránce produktu a při placení.

Před zadáním objednávky

A. Velikosti

1. Kde najdu tabulku velikostí v centimetrech?

Použijte tabulku velikostí pro konkrétní výrobek a velikost, o které uvažujete. Zkontrolujte jednotky a zda tabulka uvádí tělesné míry, nebo rozměry oděvu. Náš průvodce velikostmi vysvětluje, jak se změřit a porovnat velikosti. Pokud je tabulka nebo některý rozměr nejasný, kontaktujte nás před objednáním.

 

2. Dostanu zboží o dvě velikosti větší?

Označení velikostí a rozměry se liší podle výrobku a výrobce. Každý kus vybírejte podle jeho vlastní tabulky velikostí a dostupných možností. Nepředpokládejte, že vám bude odpovídat vaše obvyklá velikost označená písmenem, ani nepoužívejte pevný převod velikostí. Pokud si nejste jisti, kontaktujte nás před objednáním.

B. Platby

1. Jaké typy plateb přijímáte?

Přijímáme platební metody zobrazené při placení, včetně dostupných možností platby kartou.

 

2. Chci platit kreditní kartou, ale jsem přesměrován na stránku PayPal?

Při placení vyberte dostupnou platební metodu. Pokud zvolíte platební možnost třetí strany, postupujte podle pokynů daného poskytovatele nebo před zaplacením vyberte jinou dostupnou možnost.

C. Doprava

1. Jaká je cena dopravy?

Standardní doprava je zahrnuta v cenách produktů pro země a regiony, kde je standardní způsob dopravy dostupný. Před zaplacením se zobrazí přesný způsob dopravy, odhad doručení a případná možnost expresní dopravy.

 

2. Doručujete do mé země?

Ano, doručujeme do všech zemí světa.

 

3. Jak dlouho potrvá, než obdržím svou objednávku?

Doručení obvykle trvá asi 15–30 dní. Přesné odhady doručení si však můžete zkontrolovat zde: Stránka dopravy

 

4. Musím platit clo?

Ne, clo platit nemusíte. Všechny naše objednávky označujeme jako dárky s nízkou hodnotou. Navíc větší objednávky zasíláme v samostatných balíčcích.

Po zadání objednávky

A. Stav objednávky

1. Co znamená stav objednávky „Nevyřízeno“?

Vaše objednávka dosud nebyla označena jako vyřízená. Objednávky se obvykle zpracovávají do 1-3 pracovních dnů po potvrzení platby. Informace o sledování zasíláme e-mailem, jakmile jsou po odeslání dostupné.

 

2. Co znamená stav objednávky „Vyřízeno“?

To znamená, že vaše objednávka je na cestě.

 

3. Už to trvá příliš dlouho, kde je moje objednávka?

Prosím zkontrolujte sledování vaší objednávky pro více informací. Pokud problém přetrvává, napište nám e-mail: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Sledování objednávky

1. Jak mohu sledovat svou objednávku?

Informace o sledování zasíláme e-mailem, jakmile jsou po odeslání objednávky dostupné. Informace o sledování můžete zkontrolovat také zde: Sledovat objednávku

 

2. Můj sledovací kód říká „čeká se“ nebo „momentálně nejsou dostupné žádné informace“.

Aktualizace sledování může po vystavení sledovacího čísla trvat 24-48 hodin. Pokud informace zůstávají nedostupné nebo má zásilka zpoždění, kontaktujte nás: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Můj sledovací kód říká „expirated“

Prosím kontaktujte nás: info@dresslikemommy.com a rychle tento problém vyřešíme.

 

4. Jak zůstat informován o sledování mé objednávky?

Nejnovější informace dopravce najdete na odkazu pro sledování. Pokud má zásilka zpoždění, chybí nebo je označena jako doručená, ale nepřevzali jste ji, kontaktujte nás a uveďte číslo objednávky a informace o sledování.

B. Chci změnit nebo zrušit svou objednávku

1. Objednal jsem něco, ale chci objednávku zrušit

Musíte nás kontaktovat do 1 pracovního dne od zadání objednávky, abyste domluvili změnu objednávky. Můžete tak učinit zasláním e-mailu na info@dresslikemommy.com s číslem vaší objednávky v předmětu.

 

2. Objednal jsem něco, ale chci změnit barvu nebo velikost zboží.

Musíte nás kontaktovat do 1 pracovního dne od zadání objednávky, abyste domluvili změnu objednávky. Můžete tak učinit zasláním e-mailu na info@dresslikemommy.com s vaší novou volbou barvy nebo velikosti.

 

3. Objednal jsem něco, ale chci změnit doručovací adresu

Musíte nás kontaktovat do 1 pracovního dne od zadání objednávky, abyste domluvili změnu objednávky. Můžete tak učinit zasláním e-mailu na info@dresslikemommy.com s vaší novou doručovací adresou.

Po obdržení objednávky

A. Chci změnit nebo vrátit svou objednávku

1. Moje objednávka dorazila, ale zboží bylo o dvě velikosti větší

Označení velikostí se může lišit. Pokud se zdá, že velikost nebo rozměry neodpovídají vaší objednávce, kontaktujte info@dresslikemommy.com a uveďte číslo objednávky a podrobnosti. Před odesláním zboží zpět si přečtěte naše aktuální podmínky vrácení peněz.

 

2. Moje objednávka dorazila, ale obdržel jsem špatné zboží

Prosím kontaktujte nás na info@dresslikemommy.com a poskytněte nám číslo vaší objednávky. Pokud je chyba na naší straně, můžete nám zboží zaslat zpět a my vám zašleme správné zboží na naše náklady (nebo vrátíme peníze).

 

3. Moje objednávka dorazila a chci změnit velikost/barvu

Prosím kontaktujte nás na info@dresslikemommy.com a poskytněte nám číslo vaší objednávky. Můžete nám zboží zaslat zpět a my vám zašleme nové zboží s aktualizovanou velikostí. *Náklady na poštovné hradíte vy.

 

4. Moje objednávka dorazila, ale chci ji vrátit.

Prosím kontaktujte nás na info@dresslikemommy.com a poskytněte nám číslo vaší objednávky. Můžete nám zboží zaslat zpět a my vám vrátíme peníze. *Náklady na poštovné hradíte vy.

rows.source:
Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

Náš příběh

Kde se rodinná móda setkává s opravdovým spojením

Dress Like Mommy vzniklo z jednoduché myšlenky: rodiny, které se sladí, se také více sblíží.

Společnost založil v roce 2016 Francisco, otec dvou dívek z Neapole na Floridě, když si všiml, jak jeho dcery září pokaždé, když měly sladěné oblečení s maminkou. Ten záblesk radosti — smích, fotky, momenty „jsme dvojčata!“ — se stal srdcem podnikání, které se věnuje sbližování rodin prostřednictvím módy.

Co děláme

Vybíráme sladěné outfity pro maminky, tatínky a děti — od pohodlných vánočních pyžam až po každodenní ležérní sety a oblečení na speciální příležitosti. Každý kousek je vybrán s ohledem na pohodlí, styl a dostupnost, aby si rodiny po celém světě mohly vytvořit ty dokonalé okamžiky bez zbytečných výdajů.

Naši zákazníci

Od roku 2016 jsme obsloužili tisíce rodin v USA, Kanadě, Velké Británii a Austrálii. Ať už jde o vánoční sladěná pyžama, rodinné focení nebo jen zábavný den ve stejném oblečení s vaším mini já, naši zákazníci se k nám stále vracejí pro úsměvy, které tyto outfity přinášejí.

Kvalita a péče

Každý produkt v naší kolekci prochází pečlivým výběrem. Spolupracujeme s důvěryhodnými výrobci, abychom nabízeli nejnovější rodinné sladěné styly za férové ceny. Pokud s vaší objednávkou něco není v pořádku, náš zákaznický servis je tu, aby to napravil.

Proč nakupovat u nás?

  • Rodinný podnik — vedený opravdovým tátou, který tomu rozumí
  • Standardní doprava je zahrnuta tam, kde je standardní způsob dopravy dostupný
  • Tisíce spokojených rodin od roku 2016
  • Snadné vrácení — 30denní bezproblémová politika vrácení
  • Bezpečné placení — vaše platební údaje jsou vždy chráněny

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Om os

A. Generelle spørgsmål

1. Er denne side sikker at bruge?

Det er det bestemt. Vi bruger PayPal til at behandle betalinger. Så ikke engang vores personale får adgang til dine betalingsoplysninger. PayPal er verdens største sikre betalingsudbyder. Vores hjemmeside er bygget på Shopify’s sikre platform. Alle dine personlige oplysninger er godt beskyttet.

 

2. Hvor hurtigt svarer I på e-mail henvendelser?

Vi svarer på alle e-mails inden for en arbejdsdag.

 

3. Hvor er I baseret?

Dress Like Mommy er en netbutik, der drives af FKG Trading LLC i Naples, Florida, USA. Vi samarbejder med partnere om produktion og ordreekspedition.

 

4. Hvorfor er I så billige?

Vi udvælger matchende familietøj med fokus på overkommelige priser. Priser og eventuelle tilgængelige rabatter vises på produktsiden og ved betaling.

Før du afgiver en ordre

A. Størrelser

1. Hvor kan jeg finde størrelsestabellen i centimeter?

Brug størrelsesguiden for det konkrete produkt og den størrelse, du overvejer. Kontrollér enhederne, og om tabellen viser kropsmål eller tøjets mål. Vores guide til størrelser forklarer, hvordan du måler og sammenligner størrelser. Kontakt os inden bestilling, hvis en tabel eller et mål er uklart.

 

2. Vil jeg modtage en vare to størrelser større?

Størrelsesbetegnelser og mål varierer efter produkt og producent. Vælg hvert stykke tøj ud fra produktets egen størrelsestabel og de tilgængelige valgmuligheder i stedet for at gå ud fra din sædvanlige bogstavstørrelse eller bruge en fast størrelsesomregning. Kontakt os inden bestilling, hvis du er i tvivl.

B. Betalinger

1. Hvilke betalingsmetoder accepterer I?

Vi accepterer de betalingsmetoder, der vises ved betaling, herunder de tilgængelige kortmuligheder.

 

2. Jeg vil betale med mit kreditkort, men bliver omdirigeret til PayPal-siden?

Vælg en tilgængelig betalingsmetode ved betaling. Hvis du vælger en betalingsløsning fra en tredjepart, skal du følge udbyderens vejledning eller vælge en anden tilgængelig mulighed, før du betaler.

C. Forsendelse

1. Hvad er forsendelsesprisen?

Standardfragt er inkluderet i produktpriserne for lande og områder, hvor en standardmetode er tilgængelig. Ved betaling vises den præcise fragtmetode, det anslåede leveringstidspunkt og eventuelle muligheder for ekspresfragt, før du betaler.

 

2. Leverer I til mit land?

Ja, det gør vi. Vi leverer til alle lande i hele verden.

 

3. Hvor lang tid tager det at modtage min ordre?

Leveringen tager normalt omkring 15-30 dage. Du kan dog tjekke de præcise leveringsestimater her: Forsendelsesside

 

4. Skal jeg betale told?

Nej, du behøver ikke betale toldafgift. Vi markerer alle vores ordrer som lavværdi-gaver. Desuden sender vi større ordrer i separate pakker.

Efter du har afgivet en ordre

A. Ordrestatus

1. Hvad betyder det: ordrestatus "Ikke opfyldt"?

Din ordre er endnu ikke markeret som ekspederet. Ordrer behandles typisk inden for 1-3 hverdage efter bekræftet betaling. Sporingsoplysninger sendes via e-mail, når de er tilgængelige efter afsendelse.

 

2. Hvad betyder det: ordrestatus "Fuldført"?

Det betyder, at din ordre er under forsendelse.

 

3. Det er gået for lang tid, hvor er min ordre?

Tjek venligst din ordres sporingsinformation for mere info. Hvis problemet fortsætter, send os en e-mail: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Ordresporing

1. Hvordan sporer jeg min ordre?

Sporingsoplysninger sendes via e-mail, når de er tilgængelige efter afsendelse af din ordre. Du kan også se sporingsoplysningerne her: Spor din ordre

 

2. Min sporingskode siger "afventer" eller "ingen information tilgængelig i øjeblikket".

Det kan tage 24-48 timer, før sporingen opdateres, efter at sporingsnummeret er udstedt. Kontakt os, hvis oplysningerne fortsat ikke er tilgængelige, eller din pakke er forsinket: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Min sporingskode siger "udløbet"

Kontakt os venligst: info@dresslikemommy.com og vi vil hurtigt løse problemet.

 

4. Hvordan holder jeg mig opdateret om min ordre?

Brug sporingslinket til at se transportørens seneste opdateringer. Hvis din pakke er forsinket, mangler eller er markeret som leveret, men ikke er modtaget, skal du kontakte os med dit ordrenummer og dine sporingsoplysninger.

B. Jeg vil ændre eller annullere min ordre

1. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil annullere

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer som emne.

 

2. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil ændre varefarve eller størrelse.

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med din nye farve- eller størrelsesmulighed.

 

3. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil ændre leveringsadressen

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med din nye leveringsadresse.

Efter du modtager en ordre

A. Jeg vil ændre eller returnere min ordre

1. Min ordre er ankommet, men varerne var to størrelser for store

Størrelsesbetegnelser kan variere. Hvis størrelsen eller målene ikke ser ud til at stemme overens med din bestilling, skal du kontakte info@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer og oplysninger om problemet. Læs vores aktuelle refusionspolitik, før du sender en vare retur.

 

2. Min ordre er ankommet, men jeg har modtaget de forkerte varer

Kontakt os venligst på info@dresslikemommy.com og oplys os om dit ordrenummer. Hvis fejlen er vores, kan du sende varerne tilbage, og vi sender de korrekte varer til dig på vores regning (eller refunderer).

 

3. Min ordre er ankommet, og jeg vil ændre størrelse/farve

Kontakt os venligst på info@dresslikemommy.com og oplys os om dit ordrenummer. Du kan sende varen tilbage til os, og vi sender dig en ny vare i den opdaterede størrelse. *Forsendelsesomkostninger er for egen regning.

 

4. Min ordre er ankommet, men jeg vil returnere den.

Kontakt os venligst på info@dresslikemommy.com og oplys os om dit ordrenummer. Du kan sende varen tilbage til os, og vi vil refundere beløbet. *Forsendelsesomkostninger er for egen regning.

3. Min sporingskode siger "udløbet"

Kontakt os venligst: info@dresslikemommy.com og vi vil hurtigt løse problemet.

 

4. Hvordan holder jeg mig opdateret om min ordre?

Brug sporingslinket til at se transportørens seneste opdateringer. Hvis din pakke er forsinket, mangler eller er markeret som leveret, men ikke er modtaget, skal du kontakte os med dit ordrenummer og dine sporingsoplysninger.

B. Jeg vil ændre eller annullere min ordre

1. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil annullere

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer som emne.

 

2. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil ændre varefarve eller størrelse.

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med din nye farve- eller størrelsesmulighed.

 

3. Jeg bestilte noget, men vil ændre leveringsadressen

Du skal kontakte os inden for 1 hverdag efter bestillingen for at arrangere en ændring af ordren. Det kan du gøre ved at sende en e-mail til info@dresslikemommy.com med din nye leveringsadresse.

Efter du modtager en ordre

A. Jeg vil ændre eller returnere min ordre

1. Min ordre er ankommet, men varerne var to størrelser for store

Størrelsesbetegnelser kan variere. Hvis størrelsen eller målene ikke ser ud til at stemme overens med din bestilling, skal du kontakte info@dresslikemommy.com med dit ordrenummer og oplysninger om problemet. Læs vores aktuelle refusionspolitik, før du sender en vare retur.

 

2. Min ordre er ankommet, men jeg har modtaget de forkerte varer

Kontakt os venligst på info@dresslikemommy.com og oplys os om dit ordrenummer. Hvis fejlen er vores, kan du sende varerne tilbage, og vi sender de korrekte varer til dig på vores regning (eller refunderer).

 

3. Min ordre er ankommet, og jeg vil ændre størrelse/farve

Kontakt os på info@dresslikemommy.com, og oplys dit ordrenummer. Godkendte ombytninger følger den aktuelle refusionspolitik, herunder krav til varernes stand og ansvar for returfragten.

 

4. Min ordre er ankommet, men jeg vil returnere den.

Kontakt os på info@dresslikemommy.com, og oplys dit ordrenummer. Læs refusionspolitikken om betingelser for returnering, returfragt og refusionstider, før du sender noget retur.

Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

Vores Historie

Hvor Familie Mode Møder Ægte Forbindelse

Dress Like Mommy blev født ud fra en enkel idé: familier, der matcher sammen, knytter bånd sammen.

Grundlagt i 2016 af Francisco, en far til to piger i Naples, Florida, startede Dress Like Mommy, da han lagde mærke til, hvordan hans døtre lyste op hver gang, de matchede tøj med deres mor. Den glædesgnist — latteren, billederne, de "vi er tvillinger!"-øjeblikke — blev kernen i en virksomhed dedikeret til at bringe familier tættere sammen gennem mode.

Hvad Vi Gør

Vi sammensætter matchende outfits til mødre, fædre og børn — fra hyggelige feriepijamas til hverdags-casual sæt og looks til særlige lejligheder. Hvert stykke er udvalgt med komfort, stil og overkommelighed for øje, så familier overalt kan skabe de perfekte øjeblikke uden at sprænge budgettet.

Vores Kunder

Siden 2016 har vi betjent tusindvis af familier i USA, Canada, Storbritannien og Australien. Uanset om det er julemorgen med matchende nattøj, en familiefotosession eller bare en sjov dag ude med matchende tøj med din mini-me, vender vores kunder tilbage for de smil, disse outfits skaber.

Kvalitet & Omsorg

Hver vare i vores kollektion gennemgår en omhyggelig udvælgelsesproces. Vi samarbejder med pålidelige producenter for at tilbyde de nyeste matchende familiestile til fair priser. Hvis noget ikke er som det skal være med din ordre, står vores kundeserviceteam klar til at hjælpe.

Hvorfor Handle Hos Os?

  • Familieejet Virksomhed — Drevet af en ægte far, der forstår det
  • Standardfragt inkluderet hvor en standardmetode er tilgængelig
  • Tusindvis af Glade Familier siden 2016
  • Nem Returnering — 30 dages problemfri returret
  • Sikker Betaling — Dine betalingsoplysninger er altid beskyttet

Kontakt Os

Vi elsker at se familier matche! Tag os på sociale medier med #DressLikeMommy og del dine øjeblikke.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Har du spørgsmål? Besøg vores Kontakt Os-side — vi svarer typisk inden for en arbejdsdag.

Dress Like Mommy — Gør familiens øjeblikke endnu mere specielle siden 2016.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Σχετικά με εμάς

A. Γενικές Ερωτήσεις

1. Είναι ασφαλές να χρησιμοποιώ αυτόν τον ιστότοπο;

Σίγουρα είναι. Χρησιμοποιούμε το PayPal για την επεξεργασία των πληρωμών. Έτσι ούτε το προσωπικό μας βλέπει τα στοιχεία πληρωμής σας. Το PayPal είναι ο μεγαλύτερος παγκόσμιος πάροχος ασφαλών πληρωμών. Ο ιστότοπός μας είναι χτισμένος στην ασφαλή πλατφόρμα Shopify. Όλες οι προσωπικές σας πληροφορίες είναι απόλυτα προστατευμένες.

 

2. Πόσο γρήγορα απαντάτε στα ερωτήματα μέσω email;

Απαντάμε σε όλα τα email εντός μιας εργάσιμης ημέρας.

 

3. Πού εδρεύετε;

Το Dress Like Mommy είναι ένα ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα που λειτουργεί από την FKG Trading LLC στο Naples της Φλόριντα, στις ΗΠΑ. Συνεργαζόμαστε με συνεργάτες παραγωγής και διεκπεραίωσης παραγγελιών.

 

4. Γιατί είστε τόσο φθηνοί;

Επιλέγουμε ασορτί οικογενειακά ρούχα με γνώμονα την προσιτή τιμή. Οι τιμές και τυχόν διαθέσιμες εκπτώσεις εμφανίζονται στη σελίδα του προϊόντος και κατά την ολοκλήρωση της αγοράς.

Πριν Καταχωρήσετε Παραγγελία

A. Μεγέθη

1. Πού μπορώ να βρω τον πίνακα μεγεθών σε εκατοστά;

Χρησιμοποιήστε τον πίνακα μεγεθών για το συγκεκριμένο προϊόν και μέγεθος που σκέφτεστε να επιλέξετε. Ελέγξτε τις μονάδες και αν ο πίνακας δίνει μετρήσεις σώματος ή διαστάσεις του ρούχου. Ο οδηγός μεγεθών μας εξηγεί πώς να μετρηθείτε και να συγκρίνετε μεγέθη. Αν ένας πίνακας ή μια μέτρηση δεν είναι σαφής, επικοινωνήστε μαζί μας πριν παραγγείλετε.

 

2. Θα λάβω προϊόν δύο μεγέθη μεγαλύτερο;

Οι ενδείξεις μεγέθους και οι διαστάσεις διαφέρουν ανά προϊόν και κατασκευαστή. Επιλέξτε κάθε κομμάτι με βάση τον δικό του πίνακα μεγεθών και τις διαθέσιμες επιλογές, αντί να θεωρείτε ότι το συνηθισμένο σας μέγεθος με γράμματα θα ταιριάζει ή να εφαρμόζετε μια σταθερή μετατροπή μεγεθών. Αν δεν είστε σίγουροι, επικοινωνήστε μαζί μας πριν παραγγείλετε.

B. Πληρωμές

1. Τι είδους πληρωμές δέχεστε;

Δεχόμαστε τους τρόπους πληρωμής που εμφανίζονται κατά την ολοκλήρωση της αγοράς, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των διαθέσιμων επιλογών πληρωμής με κάρτα.

 

2. Θέλω να πληρώσω με πιστωτική κάρτα, αλλά με ανακατευθύνει στη σελίδα του PayPal;

Επιλέξτε έναν διαθέσιμο τρόπο πληρωμής κατά την ολοκλήρωση της αγοράς. Αν επιλέξετε τρόπο πληρωμής τρίτου παρόχου, ακολουθήστε τις οδηγίες του ή επιλέξτε άλλη διαθέσιμη επιλογή πριν πληρώσετε.

Γ. Αποστολή

1. Ποια είναι η τιμή αποστολής;

Ναι, κάνουμε. Παραδίδουμε σε όλες τις χώρες του κόσμου.

Όχι, δεν χρειάζεται να πληρώσετε τελωνειακά τέλη. Σημειώνουμε όλες τις παραγγελίες μας ως δώρα χαμηλής αξίας. Επιπλέον, στέλνουμε μεγαλύτερες παραγγελίες σε ξεχωριστά πακέτα.

Αυτό σημαίνει ότι η παραγγελία σας αποστέλλεται.

Απαντάμε σε όλα τα email εντός μιας εργάσιμης ημέρας.

Ο οδηγός μεγεθών μας εξηγεί πώς να μετρηθείτε και να συγκρίνετε μεγέθη. Αν ένας πίνακας ή μια μέτρηση δεν είναι σαφής, επικοινωνήστε μαζί μας πριν παραγγείλετε.

rows.source:
Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.

Η Ιστορία μας

Όπου η Οικογενειακή Μόδα Συναντά την Αληθινή Σύνδεση

Το Dress Like Mommy γεννήθηκε από μια απλή ιδέα: οι οικογένειες που ντύνονται ταιριαστά, δένονται περισσότερο.

Ιδρύθηκε το 2016 από τον Φρανσίσκο, πατέρα δύο κοριτσιών στο Νάπολι της Φλόριντα, το Dress Like Mommy ξεκίνησε όταν παρατήρησε πόσο φωτίζονταν οι κόρες του κάθε φορά που φορούσαν ρούχα που ταίριαζαν με της μαμάς τους. Αυτή η σπίθα χαράς — τα γέλια, οι φωτογραφίες, οι στιγμές «φορούμε τα ίδια!» — έγινε η καρδιά μιας επιχείρησης αφιερωμένης στο να φέρνει τις οικογένειες πιο κοντά μέσω της μόδας.

Τι Κάνουμε

Επιλέγουμε ταιριαστά σύνολα για μαμάδες, μπαμπάδες και παιδιά — από άνετες πιτζάμες για τις γιορτές μέχρι καθημερινά casual σύνολα και εμφανίσεις για ειδικές περιστάσεις. Κάθε κομμάτι επιλέγεται με γνώμονα την άνεση, το στυλ και την προσιτή τιμή, ώστε οι οικογένειες παντού να μπορούν να δημιουργούν αυτές τις τέλειες στιγμές χωρίς να ξοδεύουν πολλά.

Οι Πελάτες μας

Από το 2016, έχουμε εξυπηρετήσει χιλιάδες οικογένειες σε Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες, Καναδά, Ηνωμένο Βασίλειο και Αυστραλία. Είτε πρόκειται για τις πιτζάμες που ταιριάζουν το πρωί των Χριστουγέννων, μια οικογενειακή φωτογράφιση, είτε απλά μια διασκεδαστική μέρα φορώντας τα ίδια με το μικρό σας, οι πελάτες μας επιστρέφουν ξανά και ξανά για τα χαμόγελα που δημιουργούν αυτά τα ρούχα.

Ποιότητα & Φροντίδα

Κάθε προϊόν στη συλλογή μας περνάει από αυστηρή διαδικασία επιλογής. Συνεργαζόμαστε με αξιόπιστους κατασκευαστές για να προσφέρουμε τις πιο σύγχρονες οικογενειακές εμφανίσεις σε δίκαιες τιμές. Αν κάτι δεν είναι σωστό με την παραγγελία σας, η ομάδα εξυπηρέτησης πελατών μας είναι εδώ για να το διορθώσει.

Γιατί να Ψωνίσετε από Εμάς;

  • Οικογενειακή Επιχείρηση — Διοικείται από έναν πραγματικό μπαμπά που καταλαβαίνει
  • Η τυπική αποστολή περιλαμβάνεται όπου διατίθεται τυπικός τρόπος αποστολής
  • Χιλιάδες Ευτυχισμένες Οικογένειες από το 2016
  • Εύκολες Επιστροφές — Πολιτική επιστροφής χωρίς κόπο 30 ημερών
  • Ασφαλής Πληρωμή — Τα στοιχεία πληρωμής σας είναι πάντα προστατευμένα

Επικοινωνήστε Μαζί μας

Μας αρέσει να βλέπουμε οικογένειες να ντύνονται ταιριαστά! Κάντε tag μας στα social media με το #DressLikeMommy και μοιραστείτε τις στιγμές σας.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Έχετε ερωτήσεις; Επισκεφθείτε τη Σελίδα Επικοινωνίας — συνήθως απαντάμε εντός μιας εργάσιμης ημέρας.

Dress Like Mommy — Κάνοντας τις οικογενειακές στιγμές ακόμα πιο ξεχωριστές από το 2016.

About us

A. General Questions

1. Is this site secure to use?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We do not store your full card details on our site.

 

2. How quickly do you respond to email queries?

We answer all email within one business days.

 

3. Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We work with manufacturing and fulfillment partners.

 

4. Why are you so cheap?

We select matching family outfits with affordability in mind. Prices and any available discounts are shown on the product page and at checkout.

Before You Place an Order

A. Sizing

1. Where can I find the sizing table in centimetres?

Use the size chart for the specific product and size you are considering. Check the units and whether the chart gives body measurements or garment measurements. Our sizing guide explains how to measure and compare sizes. If a chart or measurement is unclear, contact us before ordering.

 

2. Will I receive a two sizes larger item?

Size labels and measurements vary by product and manufacturer. Choose each item using its product-specific size chart and the available options, rather than assuming your usual letter size or applying a fixed size conversion. If you are unsure, contact us before ordering.

B. Payments

1. What type of payments do you accept?

We accept the payment methods displayed at checkout, including available card options.

 

2. I want to pay with my credit card, but I get redirected to PayPal page?

Select an available payment method at checkout. If you choose a third-party payment option, follow that provider’s instructions or select another available option before paying.

C. Shipping

1. What is the shipping price?

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact shipping method, delivery estimate, and any express upgrade before payment.

 

2. Do you deliver to my country?

We currently ship to the countries listed in our shipping policy. If your country is not listed at checkout, contact us before placing an order.

 

3. How long will it take to get my order?

Processing and transit times vary by destination and carrier. Review the shipping policy for the current shipping details before checkout.

 

4. Do I need to pay any customs?

Customs duties, import taxes, or local fees may be charged by your destination country and are the customer's responsibility. We cannot mark orders as gifts or lower-value shipments.

After You Place an Order

A. Order Status

1. What does it mean: order status "Unfulfilled"?

Your order has not yet been marked as fulfilled. Orders are typically processed within 1-3 business days after payment confirmation. Tracking information is emailed when available after shipment.

 

2. What does it mean: order status "Fulfilled"?

That means your order is being shipped.

 

3. It's been too long, where is my order?

Please check your order's tracking for more information. If the problem remains please email us: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Order Tracking

1. How do I track my order?

Tracking information is emailed when available after your order ships. You can also check the tracking information here: Track Your Order

 

2. My tracking code says “pending” or “no information available at the moment”.

Tracking may take 24-48 hours to update after the tracking number is issued. If information remains unavailable or your package is delayed, contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. My tracking code says “expired”

Please contact us: info@dresslikemommy.com and we will quickly solve this issue.

 

4. How do I stay updated about my order tracking?

Use the tracking link for the latest carrier updates. If your package is delayed, missing, or marked as delivered but not received, contact us with your order number and tracking information.

B. I want to change or cancel my order

1. I ordered something, but I want to cancel

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number as the subject.

 

2. I ordered something, but want to change the item color or size.

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new color or size option.

 

3. I ordered something, but want to change the delivery address

You must contact us within 1 business day of placing the order to arrange an order change. You can do this by emailing info@dresslikemommy.com with your new delivery address.

After You Receive an Order

A. I want to change or return my order

1. My order arrived, but the items were two sizes larger

Size labels can vary. If the size or measurements appear inconsistent with your order, contact info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number and details. Review our current refund policy before sending an item back.

 

2. My order arrived, but I received the wrong items

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide us with your order number. If we’re at fault, you can send us back the items and we’ll send you out the correct items at our cost (or issue a refund).

 

3. My order arrived and I want to change the size/color

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Approved exchanges follow the current refund policy, including item-condition requirements and return-shipping responsibility.

 

4. My order arrived, but I want to return it.

Please contact us at info@dresslikemommy.com and provide your order number. Review the refund policy for eligibility, return shipping, and refund timing before sending anything back.

Tietoa meistä

A. Yleiset kysymykset

1. Onko tämä sivusto turvallinen käyttää?

Kyllä on. Käytämme PayPalia maksujen käsittelyyn. Joten edes henkilökuntamme ei näe maksutietojasi. PayPal on maailman suurin turvallinen maksupalveluntarjoaja. Verkkosivustomme on rakennettu Shopifyn turvalliselle alustalle. Kaikki henkilökohtaiset tietosi ovat tiukasti suojattuja.

 

2. Kuinka nopeasti vastaatte sähköpostikyselyihin?

Vastaamme kaikkiin sähköposteihin yhden arkipäivän kuluessa.

 

3. Missä olette toimistonne?

Dress Like Mommy on verkkokauppa, jota ylläpitää FKG Trading LLC Naplesissa, Floridassa, Yhdysvalloissa. Teemme yhteistyötä valmistus- ja toimituskumppanien kanssa.

 

4. Miksi olette niin halpoja?

Valitsemme yhteensopivia perheasuja kohtuuhintaisuus mielessä. Hinnat ja mahdolliset alennukset näkyvät tuotesivulla ja kassalla.

Ennen tilauksen tekemistä

A. Koot

1. Mistä löydän koko-taulukon senttimetreinä?

Käytä harkitsemasi tuotteen ja koon omaa kokotaulukkoa. Tarkista mittayksiköt sekä se, ilmoitetaanko taulukossa vartalon vai vaatteen mitat. Koko-oppaamme kertoo, miten otat mitat ja vertaat kokoja. Jos taulukko tai jokin mitta on epäselvä, ota meihin yhteyttä ennen tilaamista.

 

2. Saanko kaksi kokoa isomman tuotteen?

Kokomerkinnät ja mitat vaihtelevat tuotteen ja valmistajan mukaan. Valitse jokainen vaate sen oman kokotaulukon ja saatavilla olevien vaihtoehtojen perusteella. Älä oleta tavallisen kirjainkokosi sopivan tai käytä kiinteää kokomuunnosta. Jos olet epävarma, ota meihin yhteyttä ennen tilaamista.

B. Maksut

1. Mitä maksutapoja hyväksytte?

Hyväksymme kassalla näkyvät maksutavat, mukaan lukien käytettävissä olevat korttimaksuvaihtoehdot.

 

2. Haluan maksaa luottokortilla, mutta minut ohjataan PayPal-sivulle?

Valitse kassalla käytettävissä oleva maksutapa. Jos valitset kolmannen osapuolen maksuvaihtoehdon, noudata kyseisen palveluntarjoajan ohjeita tai valitse toinen käytettävissä oleva vaihtoehto ennen maksamista.

C. Toimitus

1. Mikä on toimituksen hinta?

Vakiotoimitus sisältyy tuotteiden hintoihin maissa ja alueilla, joihin on saatavilla vakiotoimitustapa. Kassalla näkyvät tarkka toimitustapa, toimitusarvio ja mahdollinen pikatoimitusvaihtoehto ennen maksamista.

 

2. Toimitatteko maahani?

Kyllä, toimitamme kaikkiin maihin ympäri maailmaa.

 

3. Kuinka kauan tilaukseni saapuminen kestää?

Toimitus kestää yleensä noin 15-30 päivää. Voit kuitenkin tarkistaa tarkan toimitusarvion täältä: Toimitussivu

 

4. Pitääkö minun maksaa tullimaksuja?

Ei, sinun ei tarvitse maksaa tullimaksua. Merkitsemme kaikki tilauksemme vähäarvoisiksi lahjoiksi. Lisäksi lähetämme suuremmat tilaukset erillisissä paketeissa.

Tilauksen tekemisen jälkeen

A. Tilaustila

1. Mitä tarkoittaa tilaustila "Täyttämätön"?

Tilaustasi ei ole vielä merkitty käsitellyksi. Tilaukset käsitellään yleensä 1-3 arkipäivän kuluessa maksun vahvistamisesta. Seurantatiedot lähetetään sähköpostitse, kun ne ovat saatavilla lähettämisen jälkeen.

 

2. Mitä tarkoittaa tilaustila "Toimitettu"?

Se tarkoittaa, että tilauksesi on lähetetty.

 

3. On kulunut liian kauan, missä tilaukseni on?

Tarkista tilauksesi seuranta lisätietoja varten. Jos ongelma jatkuu, lähetä meille sähköpostia: info@dresslikemommy.com

B. Tilausseuranta

1. Miten seuraan tilaustani?

Seurantatiedot lähetetään sähköpostitse, kun ne ovat saatavilla tilauksesi lähettämisen jälkeen. Voit tarkistaa seurantatiedot myös täältä: Seuraa tilaustasi

 

2. Seurantakoodini sanoo ”odottaa” tai ”tietoja ei ole saatavilla tällä hetkellä”.

Seurannan päivittyminen voi kestää 24-48 tuntia seurantanumeron antamisen jälkeen. Jos tietoja ei edelleenkään ole saatavilla tai pakettisi on viivästynyt, ota meihin yhteyttä: info@dresslikemommy.com

 

3. Seurantakoodini sanoo ”vanhentunut”

Ota meihin yhteyttä: info@dresslikemommy.com ja ratkaisemme tämän asian nopeasti.

 

4. Miten pysyn ajan tasalla tilaukseni seurannasta?

Katso kuljetusliikkeen uusimmat päivitykset seurantalinkistä. Jos pakettisi on viivästynyt, kadonnut tai merkitty toimitetuksi mutta et ole saanut sitä, ota meihin yhteyttä ja ilmoita tilausnumerosi ja seurantatietosi.

B. Haluan vaihtaa tai peruuttaa tilaukseni

1. Tilasin jotain, mutta haluan peruuttaa

Sinun on otettava meihin yhteyttä yhden arkipäivän kuluessa tilauksen tekemisestä tilausmuutoksen järjestämiseksi. Voit tehdä tämän lähettämällä sähköpostia osoitteeseen info@dresslikemommy.com aiheena tilausnumerosi.

 

2. Tilasin jotain, mutta haluan vaihtaa tuotteen väriä tai kokoa.

Sinun on otettava meihin yhteyttä yhden arkipäivän kuluessa tilauksen tekemisestä tilausmuutoksen järjestämiseksi. Voit tehdä tämän lähettämällä sähköpostia osoitteeseen info@dresslikemommy.com uudella väri- tai kokovaihtoehdollasi.

 

3. Tilasin jotain, mutta haluan vaihtaa toimitusosoitetta

Sinun on otettava meihin yhteyttä yhden arkipäivän kuluessa tilauksen tekemisestä tilausmuutoksen järjestämiseksi. Voit tehdä tämän lähettämällä sähköpostia osoitteeseen info@dresslikemommy.com uudella toimitusosoitteellasi.

Tilauksen vastaanottamisen jälkeen

A. Haluan vaihtaa tai palauttaa tilaukseni

1. Tilaukseni saapui, mutta tuotteet olivat kaksi kokoa liian suuria

Kokomerkinnät voivat vaihdella. Jos koko tai mitat eivät vaikuta vastaavan tilaustasi, ota yhteyttä osoitteeseen info@dresslikemommy.com ja ilmoita tilausnumerosi sekä lisätiedot. Tutustu voimassa olevaan hyvityskäytäntöömme ennen tuotteen lähettämistä takaisin.

 

2. Tilaukseni saapui, mutta sain väärät tuotteet

Ota meihin yhteyttä osoitteessa info@dresslikemommy.com ja anna meille tilausnumerosi. Jos vika on meillä, voit lähettää tuotteet takaisin, ja lähetämme oikeat tuotteet omalla kustannuksellamme (tai hyvityksenä).

 

3. Tilaukseni saapui ja haluan vaihtaa kokoa/väriä

Ota meihin yhteyttä osoitteessa info@dresslikemommy.com ja anna meille tilausnumerosi. Voit lähettää tuotteen takaisin, ja lähetämme sinulle uuden tuotteen päivitettynä kokona. *Postikulut ovat sinun vastuullasi.

 

4. Tilaukseni saapui, mutta haluan palauttaa sen.

Ota meihin yhteyttä osoitteessa info@dresslikemommy.com ja anna meille tilausnumerosi. Voit lähettää tuotteen takaisin, ja me hyvitetään rahasi. *Postikulut ovat sinun vastuullasi.

rows.source:
Our Story

Where Family Fashion Meets Real Connection

Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark — the giggles, the photos, and the "we're twinning!" moments — became the heart of a business dedicated to bringing families closer through fashion.

What We Do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, and kids — from cozy holiday pajamas to everyday casual sets and special occasion looks. Every piece is selected with comfort, style, and affordability in mind, so families everywhere can create those picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

Our Customers

We serve families across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia. Whether it's Christmas morning matching pajamas, a family photo shoot, or a fun day out twinning with your mini-me, our customers come to us for coordinated outfits that make getting dressed together simpler.

Quality & Care

Every item in our collection goes through a careful selection process. We partner with trusted manufacturers to offer the latest family matching styles at fair prices. If something isn't right with your order, our customer service team is here to make it right.

Why Shop With Us?

  • Family-Owned Business — Run by a real dad who gets it
  • Standard shipping included where a standard method is available
  • Family Matching Made Easy — Coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips, and everyday moments
  • Easy Returns — Clear return and exchange guidance in our refund policy
  • Secure Checkout — Your payment info is always protected

Connect With Us

We love seeing families match! Tag us on social media with #DressLikeMommy and share your moments.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Have questions? Visit our Contact Us page — we typically respond within one business day.

Dress Like Mommy — Making family moments even more special.
rows.beforeValue:
Tarina Meistä

Missä Perhemuoti Kohtaa Aidon Yhteyden

Dress Like Mommy sai alkunsa yksinkertaisesta ajatuksesta: perheet, jotka pukeutuvat yhteen, myös yhdistyvät.

Perustettu vuonna 2016 Francisco-nimisen kahden tytön isän toimesta Naplesissa, Floridassa, Dress Like Mommy sai alkunsa, kun hän huomasi, kuinka hänen tyttärensä säteilivät aina, kun he pukeutuivat samankaltaisiin asuihin äitinsä kanssa. Se ilon kipinä — naurut, valokuvat, "me ollaan kaksosia!" -hetket — muodostuivat yrityksen sydämeksi, joka on omistautunut tuomaan perheet lähemmäs toisiaan muodin kautta.

Mitä Teemme

Valikoimme yhteensopivia asuja äideille, isille ja lapsille — pehmeistä juhlapyhien pyjamista arjen rentoihin setteihin ja erityistilaisuuksien asuihin. Jokainen vaatekappale on valittu mukavuus, tyyli ja edullisuus mielessä, jotta perheet kaikkialla voivat luoda täydellisiä hetkiä ilman suurta kustannusta.

Asiakkaamme

Vuodesta 2016 olemme palvelleet tuhansia perheitä Yhdysvalloissa, Kanadassa, Isossa-Britanniassa ja Australiassa. Olipa kyse jouluaamun yhteensopivista pyjamista, perhekuvauksesta tai hauskasta päivästä mini-minäsi kanssa, asiakkaamme palaavat yhä uudelleen näiden asujen tuoman ilon vuoksi.

Laatu & Huolenpito

Jokainen kokoelmamme tuote käy läpi huolellisen valintaprosessin. Teemme yhteistyötä luotettavien valmistajien kanssa tarjotaksemme uusimmat perheiden yhteensopivat tyylit reiluin hinnoin. Jos tilauksessasi on jotain vialla, asiakaspalvelumme on valmiina korjaamaan tilanteen.

Miksi Ostaa Meiltä?

  • Perheomisteinen Yritys — Todellisen isän pyörittämä, joka ymmärtää
  • Vakiotoimitus sisältyy hintaan siellä, missä vakiotoimitustapa on saatavilla
  • Tuhansia Onnellisia Perheitä vuodesta 2016 lähtien
  • Helppo Palautus — 30 päivän vaivaton palautusoikeus
  • Turvallinen Maksu — Maksutietosi ovat aina suojattuja

Yhdistä Meihin

Rakastamme nähdä perheitä pukeutuneina yhteen! Merkitse meidät sosiaalisessa mediassa tunnisteella #DressLikeMommy ja jaa hetkesi.

  • Facebook
  • Instagram

Onko sinulla kysyttävää? Vieraile Ota Yhteyttä -sivullamme — vastaamme yleensä yhden arkipäivän kuluessa.

Dress Like Mommy — Tehdään perhehetkistä vieläkin erityisempiä vuodesta 2016 lähtien.
